ctx.x: What kind of jobs did he have? Yeah, all of them were dances, except that one we had over in Jersey. That was a two-week thing in a nightclub. That was a big show. The rest of them were just dances, what you call club dates.
And the band that he had at that time was George Dorsey, first alto; Dave McRae, baritone, and he was the straw boss, you said, the guy who hired the musicians...
